pr_body:
The test used to reuse a translogDir directory that has nother translog created in it. I believe the other one locked files and prevented them from being deleted.

Closes: #108321

comments: @idegtiarenko I think this test was just added, so I suppose you might want to take a look?
I am on test triage duty and this fails quite often. I muted with 2ef9e1ab24807c18cf67fa4d178db9d366306735
I suspect this happens as setUp creates another translog in `translogDir`. I will check if this can be fixed

review_comments: It would be nice for this variable to have a different name, otherwise it shadows the `translogDir` field.

Is this the right fix? In `setUp`, we also have `translogDir = createTempDir()` so it should be pretty unique for each test method? If we think the directory might be reused, maybe we should remove the directory in `tearDown`?

It is,

setup creates a translogDirectory and creates an empty translog in it:
https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/a0dcca2f5d00664f1e0d1bb73bb3a7ce9079f8ed/server/src/test/java/org/elasticsearch/index/translog/TranslogTests.java#L243-L249

then the test was creating another one in the same directory
https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/a0dcca2f5d00664f1e0d1bb73bb3a7ce9079f8ed/server/src/test/java/org/elasticsearch/index/translog/TranslogTests.java#L4005-L4020
